messages:
Tariq: FYI -- seeing a new eviction cluster in eu-west1-rack-12 after last night's spot refill. Pods land, then get evicted minutes later with preemption + InsufficientGPU. NICs on ToR show bursty TX around the same times.
Lina: can you share the node mix? sounds like a hetero packing/cold-start churn scenario.
Tariq: we got a shipment of mixed-A100s (80GB) and A30-ish (40GB) into rack-12. Autoscaler added them to the same pool.
Tariq: sample node labels:
```
NODE eu-west1-rack12-01  gpu.count=4 gpu.type=A100_80GB nvlink.island=0
NODE eu-west1-rack12-02  gpu.count=2 gpu.type=A30_40GB nvlink.island=1
```
Priya: Oof, mixed nvlink topology in same rack. Scheduler is leaving tiny fractional slots which backfills across islands causing NVLink cross-talk and huge PCIe + NIC bursts. That matches the ToR spikes.
Kai: quick mitigation: mark the A30 nodes as `gpu_pool=lowmem` and create a PriorityClass for batch jobs to land there. Also tweak cluster-autoscaler to prefer homogeneous pools.
Lina: I worry about eviction churn if we cordon/taint aggressively; prefer labeling + preferNoSchedule first.
Tariq: tried labeling + preferNoSchedule. Still got some pods scheduled because tolerations existed.
Priya: then short-term: cordon the mixed nodes and drain low-priority pods onto a spare warmpool in the next AZ. That prevents new pods from landing until we fix autoscaler.
Kai: longer-term fix: add an NVLink-aware scheduler score that penalizes cross-island placement. We can implement as scheduler-plugin or extender. Also add a packing-sim test in CI to catch hetero-frag regressions.
Lina: can we also reduce the default `resources.requests.gpu` for spot pools? the autoscaler uses requests to decide binpacking and tiny leftovers are the root cause.
Tariq: creating a PR for autoscaler defaults and a config map for flavor-aware pools. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PRs/2412
devops-bot: @Tariq created PR 2412: "autoscaler: prefer homogeneous gpu pools + spot-request-tweak"
Priya: don't forget to watch device-plugin logs for topology warnings: `nvidia-device-plugin` prints when MIG partitions or NVLink islands mismatch.
Kai: also add a telemetry tag for "cross_island_backfill" so we can graph correlation with ToR TX.
Lina: immediate action plan: 1) cordon 4 mixed nodes (rack12-01..04) 2) move low-priority batch (PriorityClass=batch-low) to warmpool eu-west1-warm-2 3) open RFC for scheduler plugin (link to follow).
Tariq: executing cordon now, will stream logs to #infraops.
devops-bot: nodes eu-west1-rack12-01..04 cordoned by @Tariq
Tariq: monitoring for 30m then will uncordon if stable. will post a follow-up. :eyes:
